title: WOWW: Use tvb_child_uncompress_zlib
description:
Avoid leaking the decompressed TVB. It's safer to put it in the chain of
creation than try to manually free it.

AI-Assisted: no


(cherry picked from commit 721c90996c1753b69bf4364b9cdaa27ff4ebce66)

Co-authored-by: John Thacker <johnthacker@gmail.com>

notes.body: I've never been clear about editing this file, and have tended not to. Can gtktr re-generate without discarding manual changes?

Probably not. For example, to really fix this, there would have to be a PR submitted to change https://github.com/gtker/wow_messages/blob/e1c9e15a8b94fce76cbd433cf49bd67c376a99d7/wow_message_parser/src/wireshark_printer/printer.rs#L37-L44 in the parent repo.

But that's part of the issue with this and some other dissectors (OPC UA comes to mind) that are machine generated but the tools to generate them are not in the Wireshark repository.
